basic_info.description: Priced to sell! Large fixer upper single family home located in San Francisco's desirable Outer Parkside neighborhood. The main level features a large kitchen with dining area, living room, two generous bedrooms, full bath, and ample storage and abundant natural light throughout. The lower level consists of a family room, full length tandem garage that can easily accommodate up to two vehicles, and additional storage space. Ideally located within walking distance to Ocean Beach, San Francisco Zoo, Taraval Street Corridor, abundance of restaurants, shopping, public transportation, and much more!
